reasoning_content: geocoder now enabled. Let's check openculturas_openstreetmap and HTTP.

action.command: su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && ddev drush pm:list --status=enabled --no-ansi 2>&1 | grep -iE "openstreetmap|openculturas_open"'; echo "=== curl follow ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -L http://openculturas.ddev.site/; echo "=== homepage title ==="; curl -sL http://openculturas.ddev.site/ | grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*</title>" | head -1
